name: MyShop
headline: From a good find to a saved order.
summary: A branded Flutter commerce demo connecting discovery, account-scoped favorites and carts, saved delivery addresses, sandbox checkout and private order history.
teaser: A considered storefront, with the commerce behind it.
roleDetail: Implemented the customer shopping journeys and MyShop identity, introduced feature and repository boundaries, integrated Firebase REST services, and added regression checks and native demo delivery.
contributions: Connected browsing, search, saved products, delivery options and order review into a complete mobile journey.
Built persistent account-scoped carts and kept customer discovery separate from seller-managed catalog state.
Implemented hosted MyFatoorah Sandbox checkout with verified results, saved-attempt recovery and duplicate-order protection.
Applied a shared identity across app icons, native launch, onboarding and the storefront, including reduced-motion support.
Added Flutter shopping-journey checks, Firebase ownership-rule tests and CI for native demo builds.
flows: Find your next favorite
Explore categories, search, sort and filter by price or availability. Inspect product galleries, stock states and saved items.
Make it yours
Build a basket that persists per account, adjust quantities, reuse saved addresses, choose delivery and review promotions and totals.
Complete and return
Place a Cash on Delivery demo order or use hosted Sandbox checkout, then return to private order history, purchased items and the delivery timeline.
engineering: Account boundaries
Cart storage uses a separate key for each account and serialized writes. Favorites have pending guards, rollback and protection against late refreshes. Account changes reset secondary navigation.
Payment recovery

The app restores a saved invoice attempt, checks payment status on return or manual retry, and verifies invoice identity, reference, amount, currency and Paid status before saving one demo order. Conditional writes guard against duplicates.
Replaceable integrations

Provider controllers depend on domain entities and repository contracts. Firebase Auth and Realtime Database REST mapping, local storage and payment adapters sit behind implementations; the architecture migration remains incremental.
Evidence and delivery

Flutter CI runs analysis, journey/regression checks and Android/iOS builds. Firebase rules are tested in an emulator. Automated journeys use fake HTTP data; build success does not establish live-device payment acceptance.
boundary: An independent portfolio demo with sample catalog content and demo orders. MyFatoorah Sandbox uses a virtual 1 KWD invoice separate from the EGP basket, with no real charges or deliveries. Delivery stages are illustrative; inventory is checked but not reserved atomically. The showcased version is on the public development branch (PR #18). The downloadable Android build is an ARM64 demo pre-release; physical iOS installation requires Apple signing.

name: Mahami · مهامي
mediaCaption: Android app captures · fictional presentation data
headline: Make space for the work that matters.
summary: An Arabic-first task and project manager with two separate native implementations: Swift/SwiftUI on iOS and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose on Android. Plan the day, organize projects and keep tasks available locally, with optional reminders and manual personal sync.
teaser: One daily rhythm. Two native implementations. Tasks, projects and progress.
roleDetail: Implemented the Mahami product in Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose: platform interfaces, task and project rules, local persistence, reminders and optional personal cloud sync. Adapted the credited Figma Community design foundation for Arabic-first native experiences.
contributions: Built separate iOS and Android apps with shared task, project, date and completion rules.
Implemented home progress, task search and filters, pinned priorities, project organization and a monthly calendar.
Built task and project editors, completion/reopening, lightweight Markdown notes and persistent local storage using SwiftData and Room.
Implemented native reminders, cancellation when tasks complete or are deleted, and navigation from a notification to its task.
Implemented optional email accounts and manual personal sync clients, with pre-sync backup, account binding, deletion tracking and a shared atomic sync RPC.
flows: Plan your day
A home dashboard connects daily completion, overdue work, active projects and today’s tasks. A monthly calendar opens the tasks for a selected day.
Capture and prioritize

Quick-add or edit a task with formatted notes, status, three priority levels, date, pinning and an optional project. Search by title, filter the work and complete or reopen tasks; optional reminders bring you back to the right task.
Move projects forward
Give projects names, emoji and colors, follow open-task counts and completion, and open the work inside a project. Deleting a project retains its tasks.
engineering: iOS · SwiftUI + SwiftData

SwiftUI interfaces, Observation-based screen models, Swift concurrency and SwiftData persistence support the iOS app (iOS 17+). Presentation, domain contracts and storage remain separate. The project records a successful simulator build and launch; physical-device and notification delivery acceptance remain pending.
Android · Compose + Room

Kotlin, Jetpack Compose/Material 3, ViewModel/StateFlow, coroutines and Room implement the Android app (Android 8+). The project records debug build/lint, physical-device installation and demo import; the published gallery contains original Android captures.
Dates and data integrity

Shared contracts use stable IDs and calendar-day dates, define completion timestamps and preserve tasks when projects are deleted. Local writes and cloud merges use transaction boundaries; deletion tombstones prevent stale records from being restored by sync.
Native reminders

Android uses AlarmManager, permission-aware exact/approximate scheduling, stale-delivery checks and notification task navigation. iOS uses local notifications and schedules the nearest 64 future requests. Source notes record Android delivery/tap checks, with broader OS/device acceptance still open.
Optional personal sync

Both clients call an authenticated, owner-scoped atomic sync RPC. A local backup precedes the first sync and the data set binds to that account. The repository records rollback fixtures for isolation, stale writes, dates and deletion; real-account, two-device acceptance remains pending. Sync is manual, with no realtime or team-sharing claim.
boundary: An actively developed independent native engineering project; no App Store/Google Play listing or public installation release is linked. These eight original screenshots show Android with fictional presentation data, not iOS or business results. The interface adapts a credited Figma Community design. Core local flows are implemented in both codebases. Physical iOS, broader reminder-permission/device checks and real-account two-device sync acceptance remain pending.
